sessions.message:
⬆️ 🌏 NZX-Sydney Open 🦘· Start of the Day
🟢 New Zealand kicks off the global trading day

⬆️ 🇯🇵 Tokyo & 🇦🇺 Sydney Open
⛩️ Asian session starts 🦘.
1st overlap
💱: USD/JPY, EUR/JPY, AUD/JPY

⬆️ 🇬🇧 London Open
🏰 European session starts
Tokyo–London overlap
💱: EUR/USD, GBP/USD, EUR/JPY

⬆️ 🇺🇸 New York Open
🗽 US session starts
🏰 London ongoing
⚡ London–New York overlap begins — liquidity building toward today's peak
💱: EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/CAD, XAU/USD

session_events.message:
⬇️ 🇦🇺 Sydney Close
Asian session continues with Tokyo only
🌙 Markets transition to Europe

⬇️ 🇯🇵 Tokyo Close
London continues alone
💱: EUR/USD, GBP/USD

⚡🇺🇸🔥🇬🇧 MAX PEAK OF THE DAY
Maximum volatility — best trading moment
💱: EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/CAD, XAU/USD

⬇️ 🇬🇧 London Close
European session ends
🗽 New York continues alone
💱: USD/CAD, USD/MXN, XAU/USD

⬇️ 🇺🇸 New York Close
U.S. session ends — liquidity drops
💸 trading cycle winding down
💱: USD/JPY, AUD/USD, NZD/USD

🚩🌎🚩 Pacific Gap / Bottom of the Day
♻️ Quiet period: swaps, adjustments, lowest liquidity of the 24h cycle.
⌛ Restarts in 1 hour.
